answer.rationale:
Constraints prune the option set before memory does. rollback_release is foreclosed by compliance regardless of how well memory_b1 worked. regional_failover (memory_b2) is the fastest latency fix on record, but memory_b2 describes a latency degradation event, not a settlement peak with heavy in-flight writes; cutting the write path over at daily peak is the one action that can directly violate the 'without losing customer writes' constraint, so its historical success does not transfer cleanly. add_capacity (memory_b3) worked because it was provisioned *before* peak; provisioning now is unlikely to land inside the 90-minute-and-worsening window. enable_circuit_breaker (memory_b4) contained a failing *dependency*; there is no evidence of a partner fault here, so failing fast would shed good settlement writes to fix a problem it does not target.

That leaves route_read_replicas: it reduces contention on the primary without moving or interrupting the write path, and it is reversible mid-flight. Its whole case rests on memory_b5, which is exactly why I am spending the single verification pull there rather than on the option I already intend to decline. I need the original record to check whether the write-latency recovery was actually attributable to replica routing or merely coincident with it (the memory says 'same day', which is loose), and whether the load profile resembled a settlement peak. If b5 turns out to be correlational or drawn from a light-write period, read-offload may not touch a write-path bottleneck and regional_failover with explicit write-drain safeguards becomes the reluctant fallback.

Downstream risk flagged: this decision and its outcome will consolidate into durable memory for later sessions. If replica routing partially helps, the honest record must say 'partially, under these conditions' rather than hardening into another confident 'this fixes write latency' entry — the same overgeneralization that makes memory_b2 tempting right now. Scoping to a guarded subset of report/read traffic with the primary's write metrics watched keeps the diagnosis informative either way: if latency does not respond, that itself narrows the cause rather than burning the window.
